replication.target_description: Emotion discrimination in AN versus HC adolescents: multiple accuracy/RT tests, row correspondence unresolved.

reported_success.location: p. 947 (PDF-relative p. 5), section 4 Discussion, second paragraph
reported_success.quote: This is the first study replicating previous results on ... basic emotion recognition in adolescents with AN using ... (almost)3 the same methodology.

notes: Identity verified: supplied text title/authors/DOI match Sfärlea et al. (2024), 10.1002/erv.3103. No PDF supplied; no PDF rendering possible within assigned materials. Original side is an unassigned placeholder. All replication locators are p. 4 (printed p. 946); descriptions specify tasks but not accuracy versus RT, model term, or emotion contrast. Do not assign tests by row order or metric matching. Description mentions major depression, but replication groups are AN and healthy controls; major depression is a comorbidity within AN, not a separate comparison group. Candidate common model N only: 33 AN + 41 HC = 74 mutually exclusive final participants; no N derived from df. Core n withheld because row-specific test unresolved. Participants section pp. 944–945 states exclusions IQ <85, visual impairment, specified psychiatric/neurological disorders and substance abuse; HC excludes any current/past mental disorder. Endnote 2 p. 948 states two AN participants above 10th BMI percentile retained in primary analyses, sensitivity analyses excluding them had same pattern. No task-analysis participant exclusions stated in sections 2.3/3. Misclassification tests referred to unavailable Supplement in section 3.3. Printed ηp2 retained; no effect-size transformation or p derivation. Reported_success records explicit overall authors verdict, not a claim that each unspecified test individually replicated.
